facts.text: Serve the snacks when Bond first meets Domino underwater on the reef off Nassau.
facts.why: Bond first meets Domino while she swims at Nassau: her foot is stuck in coral on the ocean floor and he frees her underwater on the reef.

facts.text: Eat and drink, Mr. Bond. My terrace is the finest in Nassau, and my pool is very well stocked.
facts.why: A note in Largo's voice, not a quote. It fits the plot: Largo lives at Palmyra, his Nassau estate (filmed at a local millionaires' home), and the shark pool is a famous set piece. Keep it without quote marks.

facts.text: The night of the Junkanoo parade Bond runs through in Nassau
facts.why: Bond escapes Largo's compound and evades Largo's men during a Junkanoo celebration.

facts.text: Domino's pour, after her swim on the reef.
facts.why: Domino swims over the coral reef off Nassau when she meets Bond, and the pour is a menu joke.

vibe.verdict: A fun island chart menu with the shark pool, Junkanoo and the Disco Volante, but it plays safe on the food and leaves out the SPECTRE boardroom.
missing: Do you mind if my friend sits this one out? She's just dead (Bond and Fiona, the dance floor)
